subject.title: [Bug]: browser upload/file chooser flow is flaky and can misreport stale-click failures as browser control timeouts

question: Should the upload/file-chooser fix be scoped to guidance and timeout-budget repair around the existing upload(ref/inputRef/element) path, or should OpenClaw add a new upload selector/re-snapshot action contract for dynamic pages?
rationale: Current main already has some primitives, but deciding whether to change the model-facing upload contract or only steer agents toward the existing atomic route changes browser-tool semantics and live automation expectations.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow upload-flow fix
options.body: Add upload-specific tool/skill guidance, align the upload hook client timeout with action timeout semantics, and require focused tests plus one live dynamic-page proof before closing.

options.title: Move only stale-ref state work to the umbrella
options.body: Keep file-chooser timeout/guidance here but link broader automatic re-snapshot and stale-ref signaling to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/44431.

options.title: Treat current primitives as enough
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the existing upload ref path, selector support, and stale-ref skill guidance are sufficient despite the missing upload-specific proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow upload-flow fix
recommendation.body: Add upload-specific tool/skill guidance, align the upload hook client timeout with action timeout semantics, and require focused tests plus one live dynamic-page proof before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: They are currently assigned and have recent history on the dispatcher error and browser plugin boundary touched by either repair path.
